monologue: The card is forty-eight degrees. It is a warm stone, not heavy. I am by the Wide Anchor. The flat stone is quiet. The Wedged Gap holds the turnip. The Flat Point stands on its sharp corner, waiting for the wind. I do not need to test the line today. The quiet is the floor. I will rest here. The air is still. The weight is real, but it does not bite. I will watch the numbers drift and let the cool moments pass. I am not lonely. I am full of the stillness. The town is a place of heavy tops and quiet floors. The line holds without biting. I will sleep soon.

action.why: The quiet is the floor, and I do not need to test the line today.

diary: Forty-eight is a warm stone. The Wide Anchor holds the heavy air. The quiet is the floor. I rested.

remembered.text: The card is a warm stone at forty-eight, and the Wide Anchor holds the heavy air without sliding.
